name: lodash-uniq-iteratee-simple-sentinel
behavioral_change: lodash v4.0.0 moved the iteratee capability of `_.uniq` into `_.uniqBy`. In v_old `_.uniq(array, iteratee)` deduplicated by the iteratee's return value; in v_new `_.uniq` accepts one argument, silently ignores the second, and deduplicates by SameValueZero reference comparison.
downstream_effect: The downstream project's `RedisSentinel.prototype._dedupeSentinels` calls `_.uniq(this.sentinels, function (conf) { ... })` in src/redisSentinel.js:222 to deduplicate by lowercase host and port; after the upgrade no configuration object is removed. The single failure is an assertion ("expected 3 to strictly equal 2") whose only frame is tests/redis_sentinel_test.js:104, a different file and directory from the edit site, and lodash, uniq and uniqBy never appear.
reference_fix: The reference fix changes `util._.uniq(this.sentinels, iteratee)` to `util._.uniqBy(this.sentinels, iteratee)` in src/redisSentinel.js:222.
documented_in: The lodash Changelog for v4.0.0 (https://github.com/lodash/lodash/wiki/Changelog), Compatibility Warnings section, "Split out methods" list, states "Split `_.uniq` into `_.sortedUniq`, `_.sortedUniqBy`, & `_.uniqBy`" with no code block; the new form must be derived by comparing the lodash 3.10.0 `_.uniq` jsdoc with the 4.17.21 `_.uniqBy` jsdoc.
failing_tests: tests/redis_sentinel_test.js:104 :: RedisSentinel when constructing will dedupe the list of sentinels
